purpose: Research-informed appraisal structure, with project scenario values retained as assumptions. No official discount rate, welfare coefficient or lending terms are transferred to U.

sources.title: The Green Book 2026
sources.read: Appraisal overview and, in bounded methods review, transfer payments, opportunity cost, residual value, distributional analysis and switching values.
sources.use: Separate incidence and financial affordability from social value; make uncertainty, counterfactuals and unmonetized effects explicit.
sources.limit: Constant 0%, 1%, 3% and 7% real rates are project sensitivities. The 800-year cases are not an extrapolation of UK guidance.

sources.title: Guidelines for Economic and Beneficiary Analysis
sources.read: Economic and beneficiary distinction; bounded review of without-project comparison and labour opportunity-cost treatment.
sources.use: Treat worldwide customers, workers, funders and affected people as distinct beneficiaries; avoid adding gross wage bills to aggregate benefits.
sources.limit: No MCC hurdle rate, poverty coefficient or causal impact estimate is used.

unresolved: Qualified demand, minimum-module engineering, ownership and saving contracts, external liquidity access, administrative and commitment costs, shadow prices, environmental losses, research and customer surplus, and the frequency/value of avoided disruptions remain unmeasured.
